object_description: three low-rise pavilions arranged around a central schoolyard
design_condition: Three new buildings are placed around the historic building to follow the sloping terrain, frame a central schoolyard, and create varied indoor and outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The precise placement of three single-story buildings sensitively responds to the site and its history.

position.rationale: Three distinct pavilion footprints are clearly distributed around the central open area.

positive.statement: The roof edges slope down with the same gentleness as the terrain.

position.rationale: Low-rise roof-edge bands and their differing heights are visible in the elevations.

positive.statement: The single-story arrangement and distribution of uses across different buildings are sensible and valuable for school operation.

position.rationale: Separated low-rise pavilions visibly support a distributed arrangement of uses.

positive.statement: The generous arrangement of indoor and outdoor spaces promises a calm and de-escalating atmosphere.

position.rationale: Central yard and surrounding pavilion clearances form a generous visible open-space framework.

positive.statement: The wooden pavilion architecture is a calm and beautiful response to the landscape context.

position.rationale: Pavilion form is visible, while wooden material is not distinguishable in the point cloud.

positive.statement: The newly built pavilions create an amazing number of places to stay with very different qualities.

position.rationale: Multiple pavilion edges and open areas visibly create varied potential staying places.

negative.statement: The space between the new houses and the main building appears somewhat narrow.

position.target: space between new houses and main building
position.rationale: The criticized inter-building gap is approximated within the central open space.

negative.statement: The interesting impression of buildings floating above the terrain is not sufficiently deepened in the outdoor-space design.

position.rationale: The terrain relationship is estimated beneath the visible low-rise pavilion group.

negative.statement: The schoolyard would tolerate more unsealed green areas and additional tree planting.

position.target: schoolyard green areas and tree planting
position.rationale: Landscape criticism is anchored to the central schoolyard, where planting is not represented.
